target_customer: Residential appraisers, appraisal firms and AMCs or lenders who need UAD 3.6 compliant reports
problem: Appraisers spend hours measuring, entering data and assembling reports, and the move to the UAD 3.6 report format adds workload; ValueMate captures a property by LiDAR walkthrough and drafts the report.
business_model: Per-appraiser SaaS subscription (about 208 USD per month on annual plan per the site) plus an in-house appraisal firm, VM Appraisals, selling completed appraisals
product_category: AI appraisal software and managed appraisal services

founders.name: Anir Prativadi
previous_startups: Music ventures reaching 100,000+ people (per YC page, unnamed)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a profitable music entrepreneur turned real estate founder.

founders.name: Pietro Demicheli
prior_employers: TruFin (derivatives and staking infrastructure, over 300M USD peak TVL per YC page)

founders.name: Vivek Isukapalli
previous_startups: CollectWise (YC F24, co-founder per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page although the YC team size shows 2.

technical_complexity.rationale: Phone LiDAR capture, floor plan generation and AI form filling are known techniques, but producing regulator-grade reports with cited sources and GSE verification is demanding for a tiny team.

defensibility.rationale: GSE verification and appraiser workflow integration help, but established appraisal software vendors and LiDAR apps already existed and LiDAR is not required for UAD 3.6.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established vendors were verified for UAD 3.6 and some shipped LiDAR inspection tools (dates not confirmed by sources opened); no action directed at ValueMate found.

market_need_then: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac required UAD 3.6 for new appraisals, with a mandate reported for November 2026 and broad production from September 2025, forcing a switch of appraisal software and workflows.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and informal with short punchy lines; presents AI as assistive with the appraiser in control (company site)

brand_strength.rationale: Only product and directory pages found, no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: ValueMate is an active Spring 2025 company that began as a LiDAR walkthrough appraisal app and now sells appraiser software for UAD 3.6 plus an in-house appraisal firm. The regulatory format change is a tailwind, but no verified funding or independent customer evidence was found, and established vendors are competing.
notes: Funding figures conflict across aggregators (130K, 500K seed April 2025, 650K, 1.15M) and none is confirmed by a primary source, so no round is recorded. The product appears to have shifted from a mobile LiDAR capture app (YC description) to full appraiser software with UAD 3.6 support, date not sourced. Dated competitor sources near April 2025 were not found, so the list is empty. Name origin not found.
